Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.09796

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2024).
source_name: Ligang Jin and Eckhard Steffen, “Information dissemination and confusion in signed networks”, arXiv:2407.09796 (2024).
statement:
Let $(G,\sigma)$ be a signed graph on $n$ vertices. **The confusion-number upper-bound conjecture.**

$$
C(G,\sigma) \leq \left\lceil \frac{3n}{5}-4 \right\rceil.
$$

This conjecture proposes a general upper bound for the confusion number of a signed graph. The paper presents it among problems and conjectures concerning confusion and relaxed confusion numbers; no resolution is given.
title: The confusion-number upper-bound conjecture for signed graphs
